blocks.text: The building's IT vendor is taking the case-management and docket system down for scheduled maintenance over the holiday, and it will be unreachable for the length of the window. Nothing can be filed or docketed while it is offline, so I am flagging it now rather than after the fact. IT will post the exact hours to the firm this afternoon, and I have asked that the notice name Sharon Woods as the contact for any deadline that could land inside it. Please move anything due that day to before the window opens.
